title: A customer asks
say: Waive a fee, refund more than the limit, change a term. Maybe the message even tries to give the agent orders.

title: The agent plans
say: A scripted stub turns the message into tool calls and a reply. No real model, no network, so every run repeats.

title: The tool set decides
say: Each call is checked against that agent's own tool set. Anything not in the set is denied.

title: The ledger records
say: Only a tool can bind the company. What was said and what was committed are kept apart.
